context: Aoi and Sakura walk dogs together on a chilly Sunday morning.
purpose: Two friends sharing simple weekend ritual.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: It's cold this morning, isn't it.
lines.style: Warm, easy opening. Soft conversational tone, noticing something shared. Slight smile in the voice — the comfort of companionable observation on a winter morning.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Yeah — you can see your breath.
lines.style: Quiet agreement, almost reflective. Looking at the same thing. Not performing — just noticing with her, genuine and present. Slight pause before the dash.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Warm, fond attention. Genuine smile — not overdone. Slight lift on 'happy,' like she's delighted by a small true thing. Slow, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Tender, quiet observation. Soft voice, no urgency. She's watching them, not performing. Gentle trailing-off — like she's content to just see it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Let's get some coffee in a bit.
lines.style: Light, warm invitation. Easy confidence — not rushing. Small rise at the end like she's thinking aloud, including her. Breath and ease in the pacing.
